title: GPT-5.5 joins the model list; Grok gets reference images
summary:
GPT-5.5, AssemblyAI transcription, and Grok reference images arrived alongside fixes for uploads, image routing, and checkout credits.

GPT-5.5 was added for text and image input, tool calling, and reasoning with a 1M-token context. It requires a paid balance. Grok Imagine and Grok Imagine Pro gained image-to-image generation from one reference image, including uploads in Play.

The transcription endpoint gained Universal-2 and Universal-3 Pro, with text, JSON, and subtitle responses. Responses identify the model used if Universal-3 Pro falls back to Universal-2. SDK types and CLI model hints were updated, and the models gained an AssemblyAI logo in Enter.

Image and video generation handlers moved into the gen gateway. A follow-up adjusted image-server registration timing to avoid excluding healthy servers during request bursts. A community fix corrected API-key validation for media uploads, including uploads from Play; another made reordered text query parameters share a cache entry.

highlights.title: GPT-5.5 joins the lineup
highlights.text: Use `gpt-5.5` for reasoning and tool calling with text or image input and a 1M-token context. A paid balance is required. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5.5).

highlights.title: AssemblyAI speech-to-text
highlights.text: Transcribe audio with Universal-2 or Universal-3 Pro through `/v1/audio/transcriptions`. Choose text, JSON, SRT, or VTT output. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Reference images for Grok
highlights.text: Give Grok Imagine or Grok Imagine Pro a reference image to generate an edit. You can upload one in Play; if you supply several, only the first is used. [Open Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: Pipe a key into polli
highlights.text: Use `polli auth login --with-token` to read an existing API key from stdin, without putting it in a command argument.
